title: DeepHealthResponse
description: Deep dependency health probe. ADMIN ONLY — check detail strings may carry backend hostnames/versions, so this response is never returned to a non-admin. Checks are the stores (`vector`, `text`, `graph`, `jobstore`) and, since #751, the dependencies a request can route around: `reranker` (crossencoder sidecar `/ready`), `embedder` (embedding sidecar `/ready`, or `/v1/models` on an OpenAI-style embedding API), `llm` (`/v1/models`), `ingest_engine` (GoWe `/api/v1/health` when INGEST_BACKEND=gowe) and `doi_resolver`. A dependency that is not configured reports `state: disabled` with `ok: true` and does not degrade the overall status. Each probe is bounded (3 s) and its verdict is cached per process (about 10 s) and shared with the request path, so a poller never becomes load and `/v1/health/deep` says what the last real call saw. `status` is `degraded` when any check is neither ok nor disabled.

state.description: Finer verdict than `ok` (which stays for compatibility and is true for `ok` and `disabled`): `ok` — the probe or the last real call succeeded; `degraded` — it answered, but not well (a sidecar still loading, a malformed answer); `down` — no usable answer (transport error, timeout, 5xx); `disabled` — not configured on this server, so there is nothing to probe.
